app_fee.value: No application fee is stated on the doctoral admission pages checked.

fee_waiver.value: No application-fee waiver is described on the doctoral admission pages checked.

gre_general.value: No GRE requirement appears on the doctoral admission pages checked.

toefl_min.value: Generally not needed for TU Wien doctoral applications; the TOEFL 87 and IELTS 6.5 minimums on its English page are listed for other applicants.
toefl_min.quote: For applications for admission to a doctoral programme proof of language proficiency is generally not necessary.

ielts_min.value: Generally not needed for TU Wien doctoral applications, so no IELTS band is required.
ielts_min.quote: For applications for admission to a doctoral programme proof of language proficiency is generally not necessary.

english_waiver.value: No English certificate is generally needed for a TU Wien doctoral application, so an English-medium degree from India needs no waiver. For TU Wien's master's route, India is not on the English-medium country list.
english_waiver.quote: For applications for admission to a doctoral programme proof of language proficiency is generally not necessary.

also.quote: Confirmations on the medium of instruction being English will only be accepted if the degree programme has been completed at a recognised post-secundary educational institution in one of the following countries: member states in EU/EEA ... United States of America

notes: Doctoral studies are run as three official umbrella programmes: Engineering Sciences (796 700), Natural Sciences (796 600) and Social and Economic Sciences (796 300). Non-EU doctoral students pay tuition of EUR 726.72 per semester from the first semester, plus the OeH fee (tuition-fee page); this is not an application fee. Electronic applications are not considered. Supervision confirmation is required.
